headline: 130 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Hagen Fire in OR, threatening 1,024 structures.

active_threats.name: Hagen
active_threats.narrative: The Hagen Fire in Umatilla County, OR has burned 61,385 acres and is 60% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **1,024 structures threatened**. 785 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 27 mph, sustained near 11) with humidity as low as 24%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (W) is not currently aligned toward Athena city, the nearest community of size, 13 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: HIGH  - core use case; downscale the sustained flow

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over WY: Casper city, Riverton city, Rawlins city, Lander city, and Mills town and 5 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 9% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
